However, when piece E is rotated or turned over in every possible way, the required arrangement of its four-square arm plus the protruding top/stem cannot be matched anywhere in the grid of the source sheet without including a missing square outside the sheet.

Thus the piece that CANNOT be cut out is E.

\[
\boxed{\text{E}}
\]
